name: rust-cargo-build
tagline_zh: 依赖冲突、feature 打架、交叉编译失败、CI 上能跑本地不能跑——它按 Cargo.toml。
tagline_en: Dependency conflicts, feature fights, cross-compile failures, CI-only breakage: it walks Cargo.toml, profiles.
desc_en: Configure, operate, diagnose, and automate Cargo for Rust packages and workspaces. Cover manifests and targets, commands, dependency resolution and features, profiles, build scripts, configuration and environment variables, caches and build diagnostics, cross-compilation, registries, packaging, publishing, metadata, CI reproducibility, and stable-versus-nightly feature gates. Use for Cargo.toml, C
why_zh: 不是背命令手册，而是把解析、feature 统一、profile 继承、缓存失效当成一条因果链来推。
why_en: Not a command cheat sheet: it treats resolution, feature unification, profile inheritance and cache invalidation as one causal.
limit_zh: 只管 Cargo 与 Rust 包/工作区本身：不写业务代码、不调 rustc 的借用检查错误。
limit_en: Cargo and Rust packages/workspaces only: no app code, no borrow-checker fixes, no advice on whether to split a workspace; non-Cargo builds (Bazel.
title_en: Cargo from broken build to crates.io publish
